none: PAS NLM-9FEC02: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Copy Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Fallen Horseman issue of 355-361, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Diademed bust right. Obverse inscription: [--]ONS[--]. Reverse description: Soldier advancing left spearing fallen horseman, the blundered image shows a small mounted horseman grappling the descending spear. Reverse inscription: [FEL TEMP REPARATIO]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 9.4mm, Weight: 0.57gms, die axis: 3
